headlines.title: Arsenal want Kroupi in January - Tuesday's gossip
headlines.description: Arsenal want to boost their striking options with Bournemouth's Eli Junior Kroupi, Manchester United scout Borussia Dortmund quartet, plus more.

headlines.title: Every goal from the Women's Super League - matchweek eight
headlines.description: Watch every goal from across the WSL in match week eight, from Chelsea's thrashing to Arsenal's late equaliser, in an eventful weekend of action.

headlines.title: Arsenal move clear at the top with a rare win at Liverpool
headlines.description: Arsenal win at Anfield for the first time since 2012 to earn a three-point lead at the top of the Premier League table following an end-to-end match that leaves Liverpool frustrated to have taken nothing.
